hero.headline: Conquer the Powder Snowboarding
hero.description: Discover the rhythm, thrilling edge turns, and serene majesty of alpine snowboard adventures around the world's most breathtaking peaks.

overview.title: Overview of Alpine Snowboarding
overview.subtitle: Understanding the art, history, and excitement of carving across snow-covered mountains.

cards.title: The Discipline
cards.description: Alpine snowboarding involves carving down snow-covered slopes on a single board with fixed bindings. It emphasizes continuous edge control, stance rotation, and fluid momentum.

cards.title: Health Benefits
cards.description: Snowboarding provides an intense core and lower-body workout, builds dynamic balance and joint agility, and boosts mental endurance through mountain immersion.

cards.title: Trail Rating System
cards.description: Slopes are categorized by color: Green Circles for beginners, Blue Squares for intermediate riders, Black Diamonds for advanced, and Double Blacks for expert terrain.

equipment.title: Essential Gear & Equipment
equipment.subtitle: Proper equipment ensures both peak performance and complete mountain safety.

cards.title: 1. Snowboard & Bindings
cards.description: Modern carving snowboards feature progressive sidecuts and stiff flex profiles. Custom strap or step-on bindings transfer heel-to-toe force directly to your edges.

cards.title: 2. Snowboard Boots
cards.description: Boots are your primary point of control. Specialized boots with quick-lace systems keep your ankles supported and eliminate heel lift during deep turns.

cards.title: 3. Helmets & Goggles
cards.description: Safety starts at the top. Helmets protect against high-velocity impacts, while wide-field, anti-fog goggles preserve peripheral vision on overcast days.
